title: The Spirit Who Stole Children From The Ice
hook: She heard her daughter's voice calling from under the frozen sea

scenes.text: A mother's cry echoed across the frozen tundra of Nunavut. Her seven-year-old daughter had vanished from their igloo overnight.
The Inuit elders told her of the Qalupalik. A pale sea spirit with green hair who lived beneath the ice.
She knew the story. The Qalupalik lured children close with a song that sounded like a mother calling their name.
That night, the mother climbed onto the ice with her own child on her back. She waited for the song.
visual_keywords: vast flat ice sheet under stars

scenes.text: The singing began. The voice seemed to come from everywhere and nowhere. Her child gripped her shoulders tightly.
visual_keywords: close-up of small hands gripping fabric

scenes.text: The mother leaned over the edge and screamed back at the sea. The song stopped. She dragged her child away and never looked back.
visual_keywords: mother pulling child from ice edge
